title: The Missing Tin Robot
scene: Between 3:10 and 3:30 PM, the wind-up tin robot vanished from the display shelf. A mirror in the back alcove reflects the whole room.

suspects.name: Edgar Pratt
suspects.testimony: I sorted model trains in the back alcove from 3:05 to 3:35 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The alcove mirror and Phoebe's view from the counter confirm Edgar was alone from 3:05 to 3:35 PM.

suspects.name: Lydia Knox
suspects.testimony: I was in the back alcove with Edgar from 3:05 to 3:35 PM, helping him pack the model trains.
suspects.contradiction: Phoebe saw Edgar alone in the alcove, and the tin robot was tucked inside Lydia's coat pocket.

suspects.name: Phoebe Tran
suspects.testimony: I wrapped gifts at the counter facing the open alcove from 3:05 to 3:35 PM; only Edgar was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: Three shoppers watched Phoebe wrapping gifts at the counter from 3:05 to 3:35 PM.

suspects.name: Calvin Rowe
suspects.testimony: I dusted dollhouses right beside the display shelf from 3:10 to 3:30 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop security camera shows Calvin dusting dollhouses continuously from 3:10 to 3:30 PM.
